messages.subject: RE: Letter Before Action - Verdant Energy Systems Limited / Calderhall Cells Limited
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

We are instructed by Calderhall Cells Limited and write in acknowledgement of your letter before action of 7 February. Our client denies that the cells were defective on delivery; its batch-release records show that all cells passed end-of-line testing. Our client's preliminary view is that the behaviour described is attributable to your client's integration and thermal management. A full response will follow within the protocol period. We put you on notice that our client will rely on clauses 11 and 12 of the Agreement.

Yours sincerely,
Eleanor Renton | Partner | Renton Maddox LLP

messages.snippet: Dear Ms Whitfield, Further to our acknowledgement, our client's substantive response is as follows.
messages.subject: RE: Letter Before Action - Verdant Energy Systems Limited / Calderhall Cells Limited
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Further to our acknowledgement, our client's substantive response is as follows. Liability is denied in full. The cells conformed to specification on delivery and were deemed accepted under clause 12. In any event, our client's liability is capped under clause 11.1 and it is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit or third-party liabilities under clause 11.2 - which excludes the liquidated damages and lost-revenue heads in your schedule. Our client is, without admission, willing to inspect the affected cells under clause 9.

We do not consider proceedings to be necessary or proportionate.

Yours sincerely,
Eleanor Renton | Partner | Renton Maddox LLP
